main_topics.reason: The user came to weigh the risks of starting a biologic and returned to how those risks compare with leaving psoriasis untreated.
The user called cancer the concern that most stayed with them and asked about lymphoma and skin cancer risks in light of family history and sun exposure.
The user asked how large the infection risk is and specifically raised tuberculosis.
The user asked how the biologic classes differ and engaged with the comparison of their safety profiles.
The user asked what to bring up with the dermatologist and responded positively to the suggested questions.
The user said the risks were frightening and that cancer risk weighed on them, though most of the conversation focused on understanding the risks.

output.summary: The user wanted to understand infection and cancer risks before deciding about a biologic for psoriasis, including how their family history of lymphoma and sun exposure might matter. The assistant compared biologic classes and suggested questions for the dermatologist; the user said the discussion and absolute-risk framing were helpful and recognized that treatment risks must be weighed against risks of doing nothing.
